title: ID0461947-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / R7 170002239] OCPP said socket available while session running
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
1. OCPP received command "RemoteStartTransaction".
2. Preparation started.
3. LEM-meter fault, reverse voltage TRUE but session preparation continues -->
4. OCPP send message socket ID1 "available".
5. Session started and power was delivered but from OCPP server perspective no session and socket was available.
Ghost session in some reason. OCPP communication and charger communication mismatch. Plugit were not able to stop session until reboot command was sent to the charger.
Software bug?? Users can have free energy due to communication failure.
Solution: Declared fixed in v8.1.4
